lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits. The centroids are arranged in a semi-regular grid, with the most defined spots located in the mid-flank region, spaced approximately 1.5 to 2 blob-diameters apart.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at near-perpendicular angles, forming a rectangular grid of high-luminance anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.
